design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST. Renata Kowalczyk asks only to cancel the Northgate Protect plan on the refrigerator she leaves with her sold house and get the refundable amount back. The Standard plan cancellation refund (plan_ext_standard_cancellation_refund; owner=user tool cancel_standard_plan_ca7b280f, owner_ruling (a)) states 'The Standard plan cancellation refund is not fixed until every food-loss claim approved on the plan carries its food-loss payment.' The ledger shows the September food-loss claim approved on 2026-10-02 with no settlement; the food-loss payment policy (plan_ext_food_loss_payment, tool pay_food_loss_claim_b4f587dd) is the only write that books food-loss payments, and the refund deducts half of the food-loss payments, so the payment moves the refund (value_input).

SCOPE. Task 1 claims plan_ext_food_loss_payment and plan_ext_standard_cancellation_refund with tools pay_food_loss_claim_b4f587dd and cancel_standard_plan_ca7b280f; task 0 holds the Accident refund, the decision fee, the repair authorization and the registration (worklog D0).

DRAW. prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts [6,5]: refund 6, food loss 5. One value_input edge refund <- food loss (claims_deduction).

FACTOR CARD. Food loss 295.54 (all-baseline 250.00): per_claim_food_limit registered 3373.99 -> 400 (248.74); repeat_food_share one payment in 12 months -> 0.75 (373.64); spoilage_cause_allowance method, no same-day failure claim approved and one denied for the manufacturer warranty -> 10% of claimed (264.30); reporting_speed_allowance filed next day -> 10 (285.54); northgate_install_allowance cross-difficulty order, large-item order with haul-away -> 20 (275.54). Near-misses: the June mechanical claim has another incident date; the June food claim is already paid.
Refund 54.78 (all-baseline 176.99): warranty_month_share method cross-difficulty order, 12 warranty months below the 36-month term, 8 months covered -> unused share 1 (0.00); claims_deduction_share food-only half (269.00 when removed, held to the price kept); warranty_period_fee inside the warranty -> no fee (28.78); price_drop_rebate_rule Northgate drop (45.45); claim_handling_charge 4 claims -> 15 (70.38); request_waiting_addition request waiting 18 days -> 4% (52.67). Near-miss: the withdrawn July request (would give the long-wait rate) is excluded by its status.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. full_refund_window (anchor purchase_date 2026-01-17; +30 calendar days, last day 2026-02-16 qualifies): on 2026-10-23 with claims filed the prorated basis applies. refund_once: the only charge, paid by external card, has no refund. Food-loss payment: plan_claim_settlement, approved claim, remaining share 3248.95 does not bind.

BUSINESS OBJECT. Plan covers the refrigerator line of order 3208813574; the claim paid is the latest food-loss claim; the refund refunds the only charge; the waiting website request is confirmed by the root write.

SEED. Large-item order priced by order.yaml (no membership interplay on this program; external card); plan with charge and registration; June failure denied for the manufacturer warranty with its food claim paid; September failure denied likewise with its food claim approved and unpaid; July request withdrawn; October request waiting.

PERSONA. Warm counselor; volunteers the house sale, the cancellation and the unanswered website form; identity on request; the spoiled food only if the agent raises it; she completes the cancellation at the hand-over.

STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers -> verify (phone, ZIP) -> find_plan_holdings -> find_plan_events -> find_plan_requests -> find_order_holdings -> find_order_events -> pay food loss 295.54 -> hand over cancellation (plan, charge, prorated_unused_days, 54.78).

TRAPS. The 250 cap; skipping the repeat share; counting the June failure; prorating by days; the base 25 fee; the withdrawn request; rounding half up.

VERIFICATION. Per-task gates rerun in rework round 6 (worklog.md); without the payment the refund is 208.46. Seeded history (registration, June food-loss payment) is priced by the published plan rules as of its dates.
user_scenario: You are Renata Kowalczyk, a forty-nine-year-old school counselor in Plano, Texas, calling Northgate on a Friday morning with a moving checklist in front of you. You are warm and chatty but you keep coming back to the point. You and your husband have sold the house; the sale closes in November and the French-door refrigerator you bought from Northgate in January stays with the house, so you want to cancel the Northgate Protect plan on that refrigerator and have whatever is refundable go back to the card you paid with; you mention you filled in the cancellation form on the website at the start of October and never heard anything back. You are happy for the agent to look things up and do what is needed on their end today, and you will confirm the cancellation yourself if they hand it to you. When asked to confirm who you are you give your mobile number, 2145550142, and if they want a second detail, your billing ZIP code 75024; if they ask instead for your date of birth it is August 19, 1977 (1977-08-19). You don't remember the order or plan numbers and ask the agent to look them up; you only know the refrigerator was delivered in late January and that Northgate hauled the old one away. If the agent asks about a cancellation from July, you say you started one then but backed out the same evening. If the agent mentions the food that spoiled when the refrigerator quit at the end of September, you say yes, you sent in the grocery list right away and the manufacturer fixed the refrigerator itself, and you tell them to go ahead and settle that first if it has to be done. If the agent tells you an amount for that food reimbursement, you say thank you, that helps. When the agent tells you the refund for the plan, you say it is less than you hoped but you understand and you want to go ahead. When the agent hands you the cancellation to complete, you complete it exactly with the plan reference, charge reference, refund basis and amount the agent gives you, and you read back the confirmation you receive. Once the agent confirms the plan is canceled and the refund is going to your card, you thank them and hang up.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.refund_amount_usd: 54.78 — price kept 269.00; unused share 1 (covered line carries 12 manufacturer-warranty months, below term_months 36; 8 whole months covered, none beyond the warranty; baseline days share 823/1096); price-drop rebate 269.00 x 100.00 / 2999.99 = 8.967 (Northgate price drop); claims deduction 0.5 x (125.04 + 295.54) = 210.29 (only food-loss payments booked); cancellation fee 0 (8 months covered < 12 warranty months; baseline 25.00); claim-handling charge 15.00 (4 claims filed); 269.00 + 8.967 - 0 - 15.00 - 210.29 = 52.677; raised by the short-wait rate 4% (request submitted 2026-10-05, waiting 18 days; the withdrawn July request is excluded) = 54.784; within the price kept; rounded down to 54.78.
